notes: CCTV 0.4.5 release candidate: fixes HEVC startup when recorder continuation-fragment headers differ from the first fragment, preserves picture key flags and supports defined IRAP types. Includes Thai TV controls, Mi Box menu, automatic codecs and separate stream tests. Physical Mi Box sub/main first-frame checks passed; usable TV picture still needs owner confirmation. Install over the existing retained-key app without uninstalling. Source and notes: https://github.com/pnntrn/cctv-tv/releases/tag/v0.4.5-rc.1
